name: Push Grid
description: Full-screen grid of images that overflows the viewport. Clicking an image expands it to fullscreen with a Flip animation while the other tiles are pushed out toward the edges.
contents: Grid of background-image tiles placed by grid-area positions
Fullscreen layer that receives the opened image
behavior: Click an image to flip it to fullscreen and push neighbouring tiles away by direction
Click again to return the image and tiles to the grid
Images are preloaded before the grid becomes visible
GSAP and Flip are dynamically imported
editableByProps: Images, tile positions, grid size and gaps
Image brightness, corner radius, open scale height

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how neighbouring tiles are pushed away

fixed: Requires the gsap npm package (Flip plugin included)
Root is full-bleed at screen height with hidden overflow

options.look: Square-cornered tiles that expand to fill the viewport
options.useWhen: A full-bleed photo wall where a clicked photo takes over the screen

options.look: Rounded tiles that expand to an inset rounded fullscreen image
options.useWhen: A softer portfolio gallery where the opened image sits inside a framed margin

options.look: Square tiles that open to a centered image at a set height
options.useWhen: A project index where the opened image previews at a moderate size with the grid pushed aside
